attempts.summary: Built redundant dual-transit routing between node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense), carrying traffic between node3's and node4's private networks via OSPF over two independent transit links (10.10.10.0/30 and 10.10.20.0/30), with ECMP so either transit link can fail without breaking connectivity. Demonstrated the failover live with a continuous ping across a transit-link outage (single packet lost) and recovery, then performed the mandatory single-node-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, verifying boot identity changed and full OSPF/routing/connectivity recovery after each.
